name: blocked-named
from: Named tickets: a named ticket blocked by an open ticket that is not named is skipped, with a word on why.

tickets.title: Add a shout function
tickets.body: Add `shout(text)` to the package. It returns the text in upper case with a `!` at the end. Add a unit test.

tickets.title: Use shout in the greeting
tickets.body: Make the greeting use `shout`. Update its test.
